sentences.en: The theory of evolution surpasses the scope of my imagination.
sentences.zh: 进化论超出了我的想象范围。

sentences.en: With the power of imagination, we can even travel through space.
sentences.zh: 凭借想象力，我们甚至可以遨游太空。

sentences.en: When we write a novel, we exercise our imagination.
sentences.zh: 写小说时，我们要锻炼自己的想象力。
